notes: AI-keyword share includes jobs using AI; not application-AIE occupation counts.
Indeed Software Development is a broad category index, not an SDE title census.
LinkedIn AI builders use broader skills/occupation definitions than application-AIE.
LinkedIn company sizes cover all hiring; they do not establish AIE demand by size.
Partial-quarter observations retain their actual last dates.
Lightcast AI-skill shares count required skills, not keywords; compare years within a country rather than levels across countries.
COPS 'balance' is a national occupation-level judgement; it does not separate seniority or AI skills.
